stem.text: A circuit contains a battery of electromotive force $E$ and internal resistance $r$ connected to two resistors each of resistance $2.5\,\Omega$.
The resistors are connected in parallel as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram of a battery labelled E with internal resistance labelled r, inside a dashed outline, connected in parallel to two resistors each labelled 2.5 Ω. A current of 0.80 A is labelled in the upper branch.

stem.text: The current in one of the resistors is $0.80\,\text{A}$.
Which expression, where $E$ is in volts and $r$ is in ohms, gives the internal resistance $r$?
